title: Wooden Puzzle Pack
description: Enjoy a warm handcrafted wooden tabletop collection featuring classic block-fit, sliding, and logic brain-teasers all in one cozy package.
controls: Choose a wooden tabletop puzzle from the menu and drag pieces into place to clear each stage.
